scope: read-only code review of backed-up v1; no source manifests changed

findings.finding: Role boundaries depend exclusively on current_speaker transitions. Listener activity only adds a conflict flag; it does not refine takeover onset.
findings.evidence: synthetic_checks.json; 7742 conflict-flagged candidates, not ground-truth errors

findings.finding: Every known-role transition splits immediately, with no backchannel/takeover distinction or minimum persistence.
findings.evidence: 5-frame alternate-role synthetic case yields a separate 0.2s reversed-role segment

findings.finding: Missing listener scores become zero, allowing up to20 unknown-role frames to be bridged without evidence of non-speech.
findings.evidence: synthetic_checks.json; 762 candidates carry bridge flag, not known incorrect bridges

findings.finding: Per-person box jumps are unconditional hard shot edges; no temporal stability check, no confirmation of full-layout change, and no merging of adjacent visual/geometric cut estimates.
findings.evidence: 57177 geometry cuts not exactly equal to scene cuts;1461 within2 frames of scene cuts; 21513 one-frame candidates. Counts are risk indicators, not false-cut counts.

findings.finding: EOF black_end may be timestamp of final black frame; interpreting it as exclusive end omits that frame.
findings.evidence: black_eof_test.json;583 matching single-frame tail candidates;3 source-frame checks all meet black-pixel criterion;246 of prior269 audio errors match this tail pattern

findings.finding: audio_complete_frames recorded but not used to constrain supported audiovisual intervals; missing energy initialized as zero.
findings.evidence: 269 candidates exceed complete audio support; prior independent decoder audit confirms end mismatch

findings.finding: Sentence preservation relies on ASR segment-end punctuation and mixture energy, not per-person words/validated sentence boundaries; partition is a length splitter, not a turn detector.
findings.evidence: code inspection; 163 frame-fallback endings, ASR candidates explicitly approximate

findings.finding: Existence-only caches ignore changed code/policy; current checks validate coverage and dimensions, not takeover/backchannel correctness. Approved-reference video takes a special branch.
findings.evidence: code inspection; all-frame coverage does not establish semantic role validity
